title: Keep unchanged pre-buffer glTF readings citable
qualification: Offline regression proof, not application-runtime or installed-profile admission.
No database, Docker or network activity. BoxTextured parity remains unqualified.

scope: Exact saved reader/tool tuple, not arbitrary old profiles.
GB1 CRLF and Git/LF reader/supervisor pairs are pinned in gltf-config.ts.
Current code must match its physical aggregate; complete current profile verification stays mandatory.
The verified current runtime/environment inventory must equal the old profile's inventory.
buffers: Every buffer is GLB/embedded/data-uri, or external_uri still needs_input.
External buffers require a plain name, EXTERNAL_BUFFER_NOT_RESOLVED, null SHA and no binding.
Old inputs cannot have companion bindings. Joined, refused, unsafe and unclassified buffers refuse.
Refusals keep GLTF_TOOL_CHANGED and the existing message.
immutability: Only succeeded accepted reads use the provisional reader comparison; execution checks stay strict.
Reads never discover later companions. Native bytes are hash-checked and historical summaries re-derived.
Source fusion already re-derives the summary, so registry and fusion inherit the buffer guard.
Historical summaries omit GB1's optional companion fields; old result/citation hashes stay exact.
No stored input, result, artifact or fixture was rewritten.

implementation.gltf-config.ts: Extends the existing read-alias pattern; full current inventory remains mandatory.
implementation.gltf.ts: Preserves explicit tools' reader identity; checks execution separately; validates old native bytes.
implementation.gltf-processor.ts: assertPreBufferCitation guards all buffers before historical summary derivation.

assertions: The test enumerates every saved journey fixture: two.
Pre-GB1 and GB1 readers both reproduce every native field in each unchanged saved artifact.
Historical summaries and complete selected-node citation projections match exactly.
A labelled Box-derived embedded-data control also has equal old/new native fields and position values.
Unknown readers, changed tools/inventories, invalid buffers and strict execution refuse.
missing: BoxTextured.glb and BoxTextured.gltf were not found in permitted local sample locations.
No download was attempted. The explicit skipped test accepts GLTF_COMPAT_BOX_TEXTURED_ROOT.

verificationEnvironment.preload: Suppresses environment-file reads before dotenv/repo-env; rejects forbidden data paths.
verificationEnvironment.setupFault: The initial test command found no local tsx. Offline dependency installation resolved it.

skipReasons: Existing native bridge requires an application host profile; application-runtime work was prohibited.

notRequired.geoPytest: No Python file changed; old/new native parity ran directly in the regression tests.
notRequired.openapiCheck: No contract, route or public schema changed.

next: Supply BoxTextured.glb and BoxTextured.gltf in a permitted directory.
Set GLTF_COMPAT_BOX_TEXTURED_ROOT to it; run testRunner + tests/gltf-read-compatibility.test.ts.
Review before integration. The owner-run GB1 host-profile rebuild and rehearsal remain outstanding.
